IAS Officer Transferred After Alleged Altercation with BJP Leader in Jalaun

An IAS officer in Jalaun, identified as Rinku Singh, has been transferred following an alleged altercation with a BJP block chief. Reports indicate the incident involved a physical push or slap, leading to controversy. A transfer order was issued after an investigation into the matter.
